messages.speaker: customer
messages.content: Hi, I was charged twice for my Premium plan on 3 November. Both charges show on my card statement.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.content: I'm sorry about that, Aarav. Let me look into it. Can you confirm the last four digits of the card?

messages.speaker: customer
messages.content: It ends in 4417. Also, the app keeps stopping playback on my Android phone, which is really frustrating.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.content: Thanks. Please restart the app and clear the cache, then tell me if playback still stops.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.content: I already restarted the app and cleared the cache yesterday and it still stops after a few minutes.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.content: Understood. If billing confirms the duplicate payment, you would be eligible for a refund of the extra charge. I will raise this with the billing team today.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.content: Not yet, the billing team has to verify it first. I might also be able to offer a free month as a goodwill gesture, but I can't confirm that right now.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.content: I will email you the billing reference number by tomorrow.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.content: Hi, this is my second time contacting you. I still haven't received the billing reference number, and nobody told me whether the refund is approved.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.content: I'm sorry for the delay. Let me check the case notes and get back to you shortly.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.content: Please hurry. Your colleague told me the refund was coming, and I'm getting frustrated.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.content: I understand. I'm transferring your case to a senior agent who can review the billing records.
